stance_rationale: The FAIL_NO_GRADUATION conclusion is supported, but the draft still emits S7 alpha_scores and uses weak-signal/DPL language that can be silently misread as an alpha candidate. Revise the package into an unambiguous honest FAIL with missing challenge, lineage, weights, and covariance artifacts explicitly closed or marked N/A.

time_series_alpha_audit.comment: stage_artifacts/WT_D20260611_002/alpha_scores.parquet exists, but the requested qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-D20260611_002 path is absent. Writer/log evidence shows multi-date Date x Ticker output, but schema is Date,Ticker,alpha_z,confidence for S7 even though selected=null.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: S7_COMBO_CONTRA is explicitly -1 * z_combo20. Preregistration reduces sign-fishing risk, but this still needs a formal Z_Score_Aligned/sign-registry exception before any reuse.
No IC-history lookup is used for selection; flow snapshots use Date < sig_date and forward labels are excluded.
.cache/flow_features_daily.parquet is an explicit request-level data carve-out and is not a Factor DB direct parquet load.
No regime, drawdown, or volatility overlay is applied in alpha construction.
No financial-statement fields are used in the tested flow specs.

critical_concerns.description: No spec passes the screen gate, yet alpha_scores.parquet is emitted for S7 and the package calls it a weak real signal/DPL input. That is the main silent-override risk: selected=null must not produce an artifact that downstream agents can treat as admitted alpha.

The highlighted S7 diagnostics fail rank_IC, ICIR, Harvey t, DSR, and OOS net t. RF-A2 is also unfavorable if S7/COMBO is framed as best alpha, because S5 has higher rank-IC/ICIR/Harvey but still fails portfolio gates.

Turnover remains above the hard <600% annual mandate: monthly specs run about 17.5x-21.4x/year and quarterly variants still about 7.1x-7.6x/year. weights.csv is missing, so schedule-level max_names, bounds, sum-to-one, and hard turnover cannot be verified.

AX-008 triangulation is not satisfied: the requested qepm/stage_artifacts path is absent, challenge_note.md and artifact_lineage.json are absent, and risk/optimization/covariance artifacts are absent. A FAIL package can omit downstream work only if it explicitly marks those checks N/A.

RF-A1, RF-A3, RF-A4, and monotonicity are not fully reported. A fail verdict can stand without them, but the package cannot simultaneously preserve S7 as a reusable diversifier without subperiod, recent-3Y, sector-neutral, and decile-order evidence.

The full-universe wording is fragile: signal estimation sees 3390 flow tickers, but returns and screen are restricted to the 846-name K200/KQ150 panel because full-universe forward returns are unavailable. That limitation should be in the headline verdict, not only a caveat.
The academic mechanism section names papers but lacks page-level citations and a concise causal chain. That is acceptable for an honest fail, but not for any later S7 resurrection.

supporting_arguments: All 8 preregistered specs fail the screen gate; screen_passers=[] and selected=null are consistent with no graduation.
OOS net PORT_t is negative for every spec, and DSR is 0 or 0.0001, so RF-A6/multiple-testing pressure is not being hidden.
RF-A5 liquidity is mostly addressed by the 2e8 KRW liq_min in the evaluation code.
RF-A7 is not triggered at the build level: the log reports 267 monthly signal dates and no future dates beyond the 2026-06-11 as_of_date.
unresolved_disputes: Whether S7 alpha_scores should exist at all when selected=null.
Whether preregistered contrarian -1*z flow is permitted under PIT-C13 without a formal sign registry.
Whether weights.csv and covariance.parquet are intentionally N/A because there is no selected alpha, or accidentally missing.
Whether sector-neutral ICIR drop, sub-stability, recent-3Y inflation, and monotonicity were computed but omitted.
weakest_assumption: The single weakest claim is that S7 can be preserved as an orthogonal DPL/diversifier input despite failing admission metrics, OOS, DSR, turnover, and selected=null.
rebuttal_required: Either remove/rename alpha_scores.parquet or add explicit non_admissible/selected_null metadata preventing downstream admission use.
Add challenge_note.md and artifact_lineage.json with the stage_artifacts path mismatch resolved.
Provide sub-stability, recent-3Y, sector-neutral, and monotonicity diagnostics if S7 is retained for any reuse.
Provide weights.csv and covariance.parquet, or explicitly mark them N/A because no alpha candidate graduated.
Document a C13-compliant sign policy for S7_COMBO_CONTRA before any future package reuses it.
rationalization_red_flags: forward return availability is the binding constraint
route S7 to DPL feature pool

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: I agree with the no-graduation endpoint, but not with leaving an emitted S7 score artifact and DPL narrative in a state that downstream agents could treat as usable alpha.

alpha_specific_questions: Why is alpha_scores.parquet emitted for S7 when selected=null and screen_passers=[]?
Can S7 satisfy turnover <600% annual after actual monthly or quarterly scheduling?
Where are RF-A1/RF-A3/RF-A4/monotonicity diagnostics if S7 is intended for any future feature pool?
Is the -1 contrarian flow sign formally registered as PIT-C13 compliant, or only preregistered in prose?
